outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs (nuclear, cytosolic, mitochondrial fraction quantifications) showing mean ± SD with N=4, but only bars and error bars are shown with no overlaid individual data points.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot image showing HMGB1 detection across fractions, with no averaged quantification plot present.
Panel D is a western blot showing proteinase K protection results, with no averaged quantification plot present.
